answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, converted to a slow vesting stream, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. By the ridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A onyx of per-task receipts records who did what, and the marble of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
